title: Independent acceptance brief tries every evidence window at Full omission detail before Compact, so the opaque continuation token can push out evidence
outcome:
Low from the Claude reviewer of landing train 7 (delegation-2ba46e30-4e3d-43ad-a49d-902d9934fc9e), at src/acceptance_evaluation.rs:846.

build_acceptance_evaluator_brief tries every evidence window at AcceptanceOmissionDetail::Full before it tries Compact. Full detail embeds the whole unread continuation token (up to 8,192 bytes) and the full left-out locator list.

The independent evaluator has no tracker MCP server, so the token is only ever cited. An opaque several-kilobyte token is also a poor fit for the one-to-two-sentence rationale the rule asks for. So metadata nobody can use can push evidence bodies out of the 64 KiB brief, and that leads to more insufficient-evidence verdicts.

Fix direction: in the independent brief, refer to the continuation by its byte count or a short digest and keep the whole token only in evidenceOmissions, or evaluate Compact detail before dropping evidence windows.
acceptance: In the independent evaluator brief, evidence windows are not dropped while a smaller omission detail (Compact or a digest of the continuation) would let them fit; the whole continuation stays available in the response's evidenceOmissions; a test sized near the limit covers it.
